purpose: Read-only Phase D applicability inventory for tricks from Goal 7; no training, testing, or result interpretation performed.

phase_d_scope.base: The working aim corrector from Phase B, compared against plain aim on the fixed camera condition. The chosen Phase B checkpoint/config is not named in this inventory and must be supplied from the lead selection record.
phase_d_scope.condition: camera error fixed for the whole run; follow-up adapter value camera_condition="fixed".
phase_d_scope.one_change_rule: Each eligible setting applies one Goal 7 switch/value from its aim-only base; no combinations are selected here.
phase_d_scope.fixed_bias_seed_handling: followup_job.py replaces fixed_bias_seed with the practice seed when camera_condition is fixed; FollowupEnv then uses one seeded XY bias for that run.

applicability_summary.counts_note: These are applicability classifications for lead review, not a choice of experiments or a scientific interpretation.

settings.name: fill_0
settings.label: Fill 0 episodes
settings.design_values: Fill share: 0, 10, 20, 80, 120; reuse 40.
settings.applicability_reason: Fill allocation is a source/budget setting and uses the aim base.

settings.name: fill_10
settings.label: Fill 10 episodes
settings.design_values: Fill share: 0, 10, 20, 80, 120; reuse 40.
settings.applicability_reason: Fill allocation is a source/budget setting and uses the aim base.

settings.name: fill_20
settings.label: Fill 20 episodes
settings.design_values: Fill share: 0, 10, 20, 80, 120; reuse 40.
settings.applicability_reason: Fill allocation is a source/budget setting and uses the aim base.

settings.name: fill_80
settings.label: Fill 80 episodes
settings.design_values: Fill share: 0, 10, 20, 80, 120; reuse 40.
settings.applicability_reason: Fill allocation is a source/budget setting and uses the aim base.

settings.name: fill_120
settings.label: Fill 120 episodes
settings.design_values: Fill share: 0, 10, 20, 80, 120; reuse 40.
settings.applicability_reason: Fill allocation is a source/budget setting and uses the aim base.

settings.name: side_by_side
settings.label: side by side
settings.design_values: Independent aim/movement actors and critic ensembles; simultaneous; reuse joint.
settings.applicability_reason: Requires parallel aim and movement learners; Phase D base is aim-only.
settings.phase_c_skip_reason: Needs separate aim and movement learners; movement-only has no aim part.

settings.name: aim_then_move
settings.label: aim then move
settings.design_values: Independent aim/movement actors and critic ensembles; aim then movement; reuse joint.
settings.applicability_reason: Requires both aim and movement components and sequential component training.
settings.phase_c_skip_reason: Needs an aim component to train first.

settings.name: move_then_aim
settings.label: move then aim
settings.design_values: Independent aim/movement actors and critic ensembles; movement then aim; reuse joint.
settings.applicability_reason: Requires both aim and movement components and sequential component training.
settings.phase_c_skip_reason: Needs an aim component to train second.

settings.name: briefing
settings.label: Critic briefing on own fill
settings.design_values: Four critic updates per valid own fill transition; actor stays frozen.
settings.applicability_reason: Critic-only fill briefing can be applied to an aim learner.

settings.name: privileged_critic
settings.label: True bias to critic during training
settings.design_values: Append true XY bias divided by guess cap to critic input during training and labelled diagnostic recording only; never actor input.
settings.applicability_reason: Critic information switch; actor remains the aim controller.

settings.name: one_critic
settings.label: One critic
settings.design_values: One critic copy; reuse four.
settings.applicability_reason: Critic ensemble size is independent of action dimension.

settings.name: one_update
settings.label: One update per new step
settings.design_values: One critic update per valid new step, actor every update; reuse four.
settings.applicability_reason: Update ratio is independent of action dimension.

settings.name: aim_cap_50um
settings.label: Aim cap 0.05 mm
settings.design_values: 0.05 mm aim nudge cap; reuse 0.1 mm; guess cap stays 3 mm.
settings.applicability_reason: Directly changes the aim nudge cap.
settings.phase_c_skip_reason: An aim nudge cap cannot change a movement-only learner.

settings.name: aim_cap_200um
settings.label: Aim cap 0.2 mm
settings.design_values: 0.2 mm aim nudge cap; reuse 0.1 mm; guess cap stays 3 mm.
settings.applicability_reason: Directly changes the aim nudge cap.
settings.phase_c_skip_reason: An aim nudge cap cannot change a movement-only learner.

settings.name: movement_cap_400um
settings.label: Movement cap 0.4 mm
settings.design_values: 0.4 mm movement cap; reuse 0.2 mm.
settings.applicability_reason: Changes movement-output scaling; the aim-only controller has two aim outputs.

settings.name: final_decider
settings.label: Final critic decider
settings.design_values: Rate zero, aim only, movement only, both, half both, 1.5 times both clipped, half aim plus movement, aim plus half movement.
settings.applicability_reason: The original decider includes zero and aim-only choices; FollowupLearner has a two-output branch scoring zero/full/half/clipped-1.5 aim actions.
settings.adapter_gap_or_scope_note: The current two-output adapter uses four aim candidates; the five-output original lists eight candidates. The movement-containing candidates have no aim-only counterpart; exact mapping is documented for lead review.

settings.name: near_hole
settings.label: Hand over near hole
settings.design_values: Active when observed absolute height <15 mm and observed XY distance <10 mm; otherwise zero correction.
settings.applicability_reason: The Goal 7 definition gates the aim correction by observed height and XY distance.
settings.adapter_gap_or_scope_note: FollowupEnv.next_guess overrides the parent implementation and does not apply near_hole_gate; the config flag exists but is currently ignored by this override.

settings.name: contact_cap
settings.label: Contact-dependent movement cap
settings.design_values: Nominal cap times 0.5 below 5 N sensor force, times 2 at or above 5 N.
settings.applicability_reason: Scales the movement cap from force; it does not alter the aim nudge.

settings.name: uncertainty_cap
settings.label: Old-policy uncertainty cap
settings.design_values: Each axis nominal cap times clip(2 times frozen-policy pre-tanh action standard deviation, 0.5, 2); no sampling.
settings.applicability_reason: Scales movement output caps from policy uncertainty; it does not alter the aim nudge.

settings.name: classification
settings.label: Classification critic loss
settings.design_values: Sigmoid critic output with binary cross entropy and same discounted target; raw Q is not a finite-episode probability.
settings.applicability_reason: Changes critic loss/score shape without requiring movement outputs.

settings.name: three_step
settings.label: Three-step credit
settings.design_values: Three-step discounted return plus bootstrap; cut at success or time limit; retain bootstrap at time limit.
settings.applicability_reason: Changes critic target horizon, independent of action dimension.

settings.name: return_floor
settings.label: Observed return floor
settings.design_values: Bellman target at least the discounted observed return to the end of its own practice episode.
settings.applicability_reason: Changes critic target floor, independent of action dimension.

settings.name: force_penalty
settings.label: Force penalty (peak force reported)
settings.design_values: Subtract 0.001 times max(force minus 15 N, 0) times 0.02 seconds per valid step; unchanged success test; report peak force.
settings.applicability_reason: The specified change is a force-based reward subtraction and existing FollowupRunner/prepare_training_data path supports it for the aim learner.
settings.adapter_gap_or_scope_note: Goal 7 labels this trick Combined; Phase D asks for tricks that make sense for aim. This is a scope ambiguity for lead review even though the code path accepts an aim configuration.

settings.name: sibling_fill
settings.label: Sibling-policy fill-up
settings.design_values: 40 own counted fill episodes round-robin over force_0.5mm_s0, s3, s4, allocated 20, 10, 10; recorded original successes nonzero.
settings.applicability_reason: Fill-source policy routing is independent of whether the learner controls aim or movement; the follow-up collection has sibling-fill routing.

adapter_review.fact: FollowupConfig inherits step_cap and outputs; outputs=2 uses the aim controller; base config permits outputs 2,3,5.
FollowupEnv overrides next_guess but does not test cfg.near_hole or call near_hole_gate; the inherited flag is not implemented by the override.
FollowupLearner has a two-output candidate selection branch with zero, full action, half action, and clipped 1.5-times action; the source Goal 7 design lists eight candidates for combined output.

FollowupRunner calls prepare_training_data; it subtracts the specified force penalty from practice rewards when enabled. The Goal 7 manifest marks the original configuration as combined, so Phase D scope remains a lead-review item.
FollowupCollection routes fill batches modulo three across the three named siblings; the run loop passes start//10 as batch_index. For 40 fill episodes this gives 20,10,10 episodes.
FollowupConfig exposes critic/update/target switches; FollowupLearner uses the inherited variant target/loss machinery, and FollowupRunner routes preparation/training data.
